Round 370 is planned: decision **CONTINUE**, next task **PERF-11a** (the first stage of making `/studio*` load less code). No file in `store/` was changed; it is still at `29f4b4d` with a clean tree.

**Round 369 (RETRO 369).** C passed it with browser evidence: 11 rows, `browserVerified` and `realVerified` true, no app bugs. Gate 369 was skipped because nothing changed, so nothing was published and the next round starts from the same commit `29f4b4d`. C found two Low problems in my own planning files:
- **C369-L1:** retro-369 §10 and line 3 of `lessons.md` said no evidence id was lost, but some row and round labels were. I corrected both lines (`lessons.md` is still 60 lines), and C re-checks them in round 370 (row RT-FIX).
- **C369-L2:** my smoke row expected "Undo: Move clip", but a move to another lane is correctly labelled "Undo: Move to track — <lane>". Closed as a wording error in my task.

**Why PERF-11 and not something else.** The regression round is not due until 2026-11-08. The stem-cache task (SYS-R369) only runs if root answers its architecture checkpoint. Root has answered none of the 18 checkpoint requests, so SYS-R369 is skipped for now. That non-response pattern is worth your attention.

**PERF-11 split into three stages:**
- **11a (round 370):**
  - The chat library (`@microsoft/signalr`) loads only when a chat session starts, instead of on every page.
  - A new `RouteTransition` component removes the fade-in animation on `/studio*`. The store pages keep it.
  - The script-size check for each of the three measured routes goes from "record" to a hard limit.
  - Exact files to change are listed, including a narrow, byte-exact edit of `root.tsx`; the auth files are not touched.
- **11b (lazy Firebase):** this needs a 2-line edit of the protected `app/lib/auth.ts`, so it is not a loop task. I wrote it up for root and Saba as `b-round-369/root-request-perf11b-firebase-lazy.md`, with options (a) root applies it, (b) a one-off loop permission, (c) not now. It does not block anything.
- **11c:** the ArrangementContext re-render items that were folded into PERF-11 earlier. Next after regression.

**Measured on a production build at `29f4b4d`, before and after my trial version of the change:**

| | Now | After 11a |
|---|---|---|
| `/studio-lab` scripts | 378,121 B | 362,477 B |
| Store home page `/` | 264,641 B | 250,526 B |
| Sign-in screen (`/studio/middle-east`) | 286,109 B | 270,648 B |
| First paint after HTML parsed (`/studio-lab`) | 358 ms | 6 ms |

The new size limits are 372,000 / 258,000 / 278,000 bytes; the current code fails them and the trial version passes. Each new test fails when I break the change it covers, and the chat tests pass in random order. The perf plan's 230 KB goal cannot be reached inside the loop: Firebase (about 36 KB, estimated), the animation library (39 KB) and the Studio route itself (124 KB) all remain. I told Saba this in the root request.

**Reviews.** tech-lead reviewed the trial version twice, and performance-optimizer was consulted once; their views are opinions. Two Medium findings were fixed before dispatch. One pre-existing Low (a chat connection can stay open if the page closes mid-connect) is deferred. The advisor was consulted twice. A later idea from the consult (the smooth-scroll loop also runs on `/studio*`) is recorded but not scheduled.

**Order after round 370:** regression (from 2026-11-08), PERF-11c, PERF-11b if root or Saba answers, then PERF-12…15 and the rest of the queue unchanged.
